value.rationale: A natural noise-stability invariant for iid point-sampled affine approximation is the smallest number of nodes yielding a finite *unconditional* slope MSE. Exact all-m, all-beta endpoint phase boundary yields a meaningful and surprising design comparison: four uniformly distributed points suffice, four arcsine-distributed points do not, five arcsine points suffice; the arc-sine m=4 small-range constant further quantifies the failure mechanism. This is a structural sample-complexity boundary rather than a routine tiny parameter gain.
